subject: general
question: In which Five-Year Plan, was the Mahalanobis Model started?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Second**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mahalanobis Model**

 
 
• **​Marxist **economists **Grigory** **Feldman** from the Soviet Union and **Prasanta** **Chandra** **Mahalanobis** from India separately developed the **Feldman-Mahalanobis model in 1953**.
 
• **Mahalanobis **ended up serving as the **Second Five Year Plan's** primary economist and was the focus of many of the country's most contentious economic discussions.
 
• The **core **of the **strategy** is a change in** industrial investmen**t patterns towards the development of a domestic **consumption goods sector.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Long-term expansion** of the nation's consumer** goods production** capacity depends on the capital goods sector having a high adequate capacity.
 
• The division between the two different categories of **goods **helped consumers better comprehend the **trade-off** between levels of immediate and** future consumption** and provided a clearer **explanation **of **Marx's **theories in** Das Kapital**.
 
• **Feldman**, an economist for the **GOSPLAN **planning committee at the time, first proposed these concepts in 1928, outlining the theoretical justifications for a** two-department growth strategy**.
